emblem--buddhist.what: A circular wall roundel or menu icon depicting an eight-spoked wheel (Dharmachakra).
emblem--buddhist.faith: Buddhism; ancient to medieval India and pan-Asian Buddhist traditions, from c. 3rd century BCE onward.
emblem--buddhist.accurate: yes; it accurately depicts an eight-spoked Dharmachakra (Wheel of Dharma) representing the Noble Eightfold Path, with a central hub, outer rim, and eight evenly spaced spokes.

emblem--christian.what: A circular wall roundel or menu icon depicting a Latin cross.
emblem--christian.faith: Christianity; Western Europe, medieval to early modern period.
emblem--christian.accurate: yes; it correctly depicts a classic Latin cross with a vertical shaft longer than the horizontal beam.

emblem--hindu.what: A circular wall roundel or menu icon depicting the sacred Om (Aum) symbol.
emblem--hindu.faith: Hinduism; Indian subcontinent, ancient Vedic period to modern day.
emblem--hindu.accurate: yes; the Devanagari Om glyph is correctly rendered with its three curves, crescent (chandrabindu), and bindu dot.

emblem--muslim.what: A circular wall roundel or menu icon depicting an interlaced eight-pointed geometric star (Rub el Hizb).
emblem--muslim.faith: Islam; Islamic world (Middle East, North Africa, Central Asia), medieval Islamic Golden Age (c. 8th–14th century) onward.
emblem--muslim.accurate: yes; it accurately represents the Rub el Hizb symbol formed by two concentric, interlocking squares in geometric harmony.

flavor-banner--buddhist.what: A hanging scroll or thangka wall banner depicting Gautama Buddha seated on a lotus throne.
flavor-banner--buddhist.faith: Buddhism; Tibetan and Himalayan Buddhist tradition, medieval to early modern period (c. 11th–18th century).
flavor-banner--buddhist.accurate: yes; it accurately portrays Shakyamuni Buddha in the earth-touching gesture (bhumisparsha mudra) seated in full lotus posture (padmasana) atop a lotus throne, complete with monastic kasaya robes, ushnisha, and elongated earlobes.

flavor-banner--christian.what: A vertical hanging church banner or gonfalon featuring a Latin cross.
flavor-banner--christian.faith: Christianity; Western Europe, medieval to early modern ecclesiastical tradition.
flavor-banner--christian.accurate: yes; it accurately depicts a traditional ecclesiastical processional or wall banner with a gilded Latin cross, hanging loops, and bottom fringe tassels.

flavor-mat--buddhist.what: A long rectangular floor runner mat or altar cloth featuring lotus flower motifs at both ends.
flavor-mat--buddhist.faith: Buddhism (also compatible with Hinduism); Tibetan/Himalayan or East Asian Buddhist monastic tradition, medieval to traditional period.
flavor-mat--buddhist.accurate: yes; the stylized sacred lotus flowers (padma) and maroon-and-gold color scheme conform accurately to Buddhist temple textile traditions.

flavor-mat--muslim.what: A long rectangular geometric carpet runner or prayer rug.
flavor-mat--muslim.faith: Islam; Islamic Middle East or Central Asia (Anatolian, Caucasian, or Persian carpet tradition), c. 14th–17th century.
flavor-mat--muslim.accurate: yes; it faithfully reproduces Islamic carpet design with repeating octagonal medallions, eight-pointed stars, and strictly aniconic geometric borders.

flavor-relief--buddhist.what: A circular carved gold or bronze wall roundel depicting an ornate Dharmachakra with a central gankyil.
flavor-relief--buddhist.faith: Buddhism; Tibetan and pan-Asian Buddhist tradition, ancient to medieval/traditional period.
flavor-relief--buddhist.accurate: yes; it correctly features an eight-spoked Wheel of the Law with ornate finials around the perimeter and a central three-swirl gankyil (wheel of joy).

flavor-relief--christian.what: A carved stone architectural wall roundel featuring a Gothic quatrefoil and a gilded cross pattée.
flavor-relief--christian.faith: Christianity; Western Europe, High to Late Middle Ages (Gothic architecture, c. 12th–15th century).
flavor-relief--christian.accurate: yes; it accurately reproduces medieval Gothic architectural stone tracery featuring a four-lobed quatrefoil enclosing a flared gilded cross.

flavor-relief--hindu.what: A carved wooden or stone wall roundel depicting the sacred Om symbol within a lotus flower.
flavor-relief--hindu.faith: Hinduism; Indian subcontinent, ancient to modern sacred carving tradition.
flavor-relief--hindu.accurate: yes; the sacred Om character is sculpted with correct proportions, chandrabindu, and bindu dot, framed by an open lotus flower.

flavor-relief--muslim.what: A square wood marquetry or intarsia wall panel / floor tile with an interlaced geometric star pattern.
flavor-relief--muslim.faith: Islam; Islamic world (such as Mamluk, Moorish/Andalusian, or Ottoman woodwork), medieval to early modern period (c. 12th–16th century).
flavor-relief--muslim.accurate: yes; it accurately represents Islamic geometric woodwork (girih marquetry) structured around an eight-pointed star and interlocking strapwork bands.

flavor-sigil--buddhist.what: A circular wall roundel or floor medallion depicting an eight-petaled lotus flower.
flavor-sigil--buddhist.faith: Buddhism (also prominent in Hinduism); pan-Dharmic sacred tradition of India and East/Central Asia, ancient to medieval period.
flavor-sigil--buddhist.accurate: yes; it accurately depicts an eight-petaled lotus (ashtadala padma) in balanced radial symmetry, a foundational sacred motif in Dharmic iconography.

flavor-sigil--christian.what: A circular stone floor pavement depicting an eleven-circuit cathedral labyrinth.
flavor-sigil--christian.faith: Christianity; Western Europe, medieval France (High Gothic, c. 1200 CE, famously associated with Chartres Cathedral).
flavor-sigil--christian.accurate: yes; it accurately reproduces the eleven-circuit Chartres Cathedral floor labyrinth, including its four-quadrant unicursal path, outer lunations, and central six-petaled rosette.

flavor-sigil--hindu.what: A circular ritual floor painting (rangoli, kolam, or mandana) depicting an eight-petaled lotus motif.
flavor-sigil--hindu.faith: Hinduism; Indian subcontinent, ancient sacred and folk tradition practiced from antiquity to the modern day.
flavor-sigil--hindu.accurate: yes; it faithfully represents traditional Hindu sacred floor art rendered in white powder against a red ochre ground, featuring a symmetrical eight-petaled lotus, bindu dots, and geometric borders.

flavor-sigil--muslim.what: A circular polychrome marble floor inlay medallion (opus sectile) featuring an eight-pointed geometric star.
flavor-sigil--muslim.faith: Islam (also closely resembling medieval Christian Cosmatesque work); Mamluk or Mediterranean Islamic architecture (c. 12th–15th century), or medieval Italian church pavement.
flavor-sigil--muslim.accurate: yes; it accurately depicts classical architectural marble opus sectile pavement with interlacing strapwork forming an eight-pointed star, contrasting marble inlays, and a dogtooth/triangular border.
